verdict.rationale: Bland documents post-call webhooks that automatically send HTTP notifications to your server when a call completes. It also offers JWT-signed requests verifiable via a public JWKS endpoint, and pathways can fire webhooks at any point in a conversation, so the core of event delivery is covered. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of event types beyond call completion, a subscription-management API, retry/delivery-guarantee details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
